globalAttributes.name: data-ae-adaptive
globalAttributes.description:
Publishes size and shape classes, dimensions and orientation using the Extension's adaptiveParams thresholds.

Value syntax: presence.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-anchor
globalAttributes.description:
Comma-separated target-pivot:self-pivot candidates. Pivots: top-left, top-center, top-right, center-left, center, center-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right.

Value syntax: pivot-list.

Examples: `bottom-left:top-left, top-left:bottom-left`.

Suggested values: `bottom-left:top-left`, `bottom-center:top-center`, `bottom-right:top-right`, `top-left:bottom-left`, `center:center`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-anchor-match
globalAttributes.description:
Match the target's width and/or height through weak CSS. Empty and unknown tokens are invalid; application sizing can override the match.

Value syntax: token-list.

Suggested values: `width`, `height`, `width height`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-anchor-target
globalAttributes.description:
Target ID or CSS selector. Empty uses offsetParent. Target and Anchor must share a positioning reference; an associated Present Group takes precedence.

Value syntax: selector.

Default behavior: "".

Examples: `menu-trigger`, `#menu-trigger`.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-auto-unpop
globalAttributes.description:
Automatically closes after the specified nonnegative duration. Values use milliseconds by default, or ms/s units.

Value syntax: duration.

Examples: `250ms`, `2s`.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-dismiss
globalAttributes.description:
Closes one Present ID, optionally prefixed with #. Empty uses data-ae-target or the closest Present ancestor.

Value syntax: id.

Default behavior: "".

Examples: `details`.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-feedback
globalAttributes.description:
Feedback boundary. Empty accepts all types; whitespace-separated types filter handled feedback and stop matching events from bubbling further.

Value syntax: token-list.

Suggested values: ``, `warning`, `error`, `success`, `announce`, `busy`, `progress`, `validate`, `warning error success`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-focus
globalAttributes.description:
Enter navigation on a text-entry control. Next supplies enterkeyhint when absent and focuses the next available control.

Value syntax: enum.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-label
globalAttributes.description:
Shown when this value matches the enclosing preference; otherwise hidden. It does not copy text into another element.

Value syntax: string.

Examples: `auto`, `light`, `dark`.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-maxfps
globalAttributes.description:
Optional layout update ceiling on this element. Must be a finite number greater than zero; no attribute means the shared scheduler cadence.

Value syntax: number.

Examples: `20`, `40`, `60`.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-next
globalAttributes.description:
Cycles forward through the enclosing preference's built-in values; use a keyboard-operable control.

Value syntax: presence.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-option
globalAttributes.description:
Sets a value of the enclosing preference. Values depend on that preference; application-defined values remain possible.

Value syntax: string.

Suggested values: `auto`, `light`, `dark`, `no-preference`, `more`, `less`, `reduced`, `active`, `on`, `off`, `low`, `1`, `1.5`, `0.8`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-point
globalAttributes.description:
Maximum simultaneously associated pointers. Empty defaults to 1; a nonnegative integer is expected, and 0 disables association.

Value syntax: integer.

Default behavior: "1".

Examples: `0`, `1`, `2`.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-preference
globalAttributes.description:
Preference controlled by descendant option/label/next/previous controls. CamelCase and kebab-case preference names are accepted.

Value syntax: string.

Suggested values: `colorScheme`, `contrast`, `reducedMotion`, `reducedTransparency`, `forcedColors`, `textScale`, `interfaceScale`, `extendedTiming`, `largeTargets`, `haptics`, `sound`, `color-scheme`, `reduced-motion`, `reduced-transparency`, `forced-colors`, `text-scale`, `interface-scale`, `extended-timing`, `large-targets`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-present
globalAttributes.description:
Present container. Empty disables motion; all expands to opacity transform height width. Property tokens are whitespace-separated.

Value syntax: token-list.

Default behavior: "".

Suggested values: ``, `all`, `opacity`, `transform`, `height`, `width`, `opacity transform`, `opacity transform height width`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-present-active
globalAttributes.description:
Selected member's native ID, without #. An empty value selects no member. Invalid or ambiguous selection preserves the previous selection.

Value syntax: id.

Default behavior: "".

Examples: `details`.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-present-group
globalAttributes.description:
Coordinates nested Present members by their native IDs. Nested groups own their own members.

Value syntax: presence.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-present-group-anchor
globalAttributes.description:
One Anchor ID, optionally prefixed with #. The associated Anchor follows this group's selected member; requires Anchor.

Value syntax: id.

Examples: `selection-outline`.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-present-motion
globalAttributes.description:
Direct content child of a Present container; enables grid-based size transitions. Put hidden on the container.

Value syntax: presence.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-present-when
globalAttributes.description:
One class token on the Present Group that selects this member when no explicit active attribute is present.

Value syntax: class-token.

Examples: `show-details`.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-prev
globalAttributes.description:
Cycles backward through the enclosing preference's built-in values; use a keyboard-operable control.

Value syntax: presence.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-scrollbar
globalAttributes.description:
Custom scrollbars. Empty enables both; none hides native bars without creating custom bars. Axis tokens and aliases can be combined.

Value syntax: token-list.

Suggested values: ``, `vertical`, `horizontal`, `vertical horizontal`, `v h`, `y x`, `none`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-scrollbar-horizontal
globalAttributes.description:
Horizontal custom bar, created automatically or reused when supplied as a direct child of Scrollbox.

Value syntax: presence.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-scrollbar-vertical
globalAttributes.description:
Vertical custom bar, created automatically or reused when supplied as a direct child of Scrollbox.

Value syntax: presence.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-scrollbox
globalAttributes.description:
Native scrolling with progress state. Pointer mode adds desktop mouse/pen drag scrolling; it requires usable overflow.

Value syntax: enum.

Default behavior: "native".

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-scrollbox-elastic
globalAttributes.description:
Mark exactly one direct content child. Empty uses 1/4; one or two nonnegative fractions or px values set vertical/horizontal limits. False disables elastic behavior.

Value syntax: elastic-limits.

Default behavior: "1/4".

Suggested values: ``, `false`, `1/4`, `80px`, `80px 40px`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-scrollbox-momentum
globalAttributes.description:
Set false to disable desktop pointer momentum. Snap disables momentum on every axis.

Value syntax: enum.

Default behavior: "true".

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-scrollbox-snap
globalAttributes.description:
Snap axis on an element that also declares Scrollbox. Empty is horizontal; false disables Snap. Snap loads the Scrollbox dependency itself.

Value syntax: enum.

Default behavior: "horizontal".

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-scrollbox-wheel-horizontal
globalAttributes.description:
Set false to disable vertical-wheel conversion to horizontal scrolling.

Value syntax: enum.

Default behavior: "true".

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-snap-item
globalAttributes.description:
Snap alignment for an item belonging to the nearest Scrollbox. Left/top alias start; right/bottom alias end; empty is center.

Value syntax: enum.

Default behavior: "center".

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-target
globalAttributes.description:
One Present target ID, optionally prefixed with #; CSS selector lists are not accepted.

Value syntax: id.

Examples: `details`, `#details`.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-target-message
globalAttributes.description:
One element ID, optionally prefixed with #, receiving message text. Empty uses the boundary itself.

Value syntax: id.

Default behavior: "".

Examples: `status-message`.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-target-transform
globalAttributes.description:
One element ID, optionally prefixed with #, receiving feedback classes and motion. Empty uses the boundary itself.

Value syntax: id.

Default behavior: "".

Examples: `status-icon`.

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-trigger
globalAttributes.description:
Present action. Target is one native ID, or the closest Present ancestor when omitted. Prefer a native button for keyboard activation.

Value syntax: enum.

Default behavior: "toggle".

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-trigger-on
globalAttributes.description:
Use hover for delegated pointer hover opening/closing. Touch and keyboard activation keep click behavior.

Value syntax: enum.

Default behavior: "click".

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-unpop-on-outside
globalAttributes.description:
Set false to keep a Present region open when clicking outside it.

Value syntax: enum.

Default behavior: "true".

globalAttributes.name: data-ae-wait-mounted
globalAttributes.description:
Keeps the element hidden until mounting completes and exposes aria-busy during the attempt.

Value syntax: presence.

attributes.name: data-ae-ajax-href
attributes.description:
CSS selectors for regions replaced from a same-origin HTML response. Each selector uses its first match; current and response documents must contain the region.

Value syntax: selector-list.

Examples: `title,#content`.

attributes.name: data-ae-color-scheme
attributes.description:
Resolved root preference published by the runtime. Use in CSS selectors; configure choices through Preference.

Runtime output; read it in selectors/styles instead of using it as an activation command.

Value syntax: enum.

attributes.name: data-ae-contrast
attributes.description:
Resolved root preference published by the runtime. Use in CSS selectors; configure choices through Preference.

Runtime output; read it in selectors/styles instead of using it as an activation command.

Value syntax: enum.

attributes.name: data-ae-forced-colors
attributes.description:
Resolved root preference published by the runtime. Use in CSS selectors; configure choices through Preference.

Runtime output; read it in selectors/styles instead of using it as an activation command.

Value syntax: enum.

attributes.name: data-ae-reduced-motion
attributes.description:
Resolved root preference published by the runtime. Use in CSS selectors; configure choices through Preference.

Runtime output; read it in selectors/styles instead of using it as an activation command.

Value syntax: enum.

attributes.name: data-ae-reduced-transparency
attributes.description:
Resolved root preference published by the runtime. Use in CSS selectors; configure choices through Preference.

Runtime output; read it in selectors/styles instead of using it as an activation command.

Value syntax: enum.

attributes.name: data-ae-builds
attributes.description:
Available Extension builds on a declarative link; space/comma-separated modern and legacy tokens. Omitted promises both.

Value syntax: token-list.

Suggested values: `modern`, `legacy`, `modern legacy`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

attributes.name: data-ae-load-style
attributes.description:
On a declarative link, presence/true requests the associated stylesheet, a URL selects a stylesheet, and false disables it. Omission does not request CSS.

Value syntax: string.

Suggested values: ``, `true`, `false`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

attributes.name: data-ae-load-when
attributes.description:
Nonempty CSS selector activating lazy Extension loading on a declarative link.

Value syntax: selector.

Examples: `[data-ae-present]`.

attributes.name: rel
attributes.description:
Registers an Aellux Extension declared by this link. href is an official name or compatible Extension URL; data-ae-load-when enables lazy loading.

Value syntax: string.

Suggested values: `aelluxjs-ext`. This is an open grammar, not a closed enumeration.

attributes.name: data-ae-theme-color
attributes.description:
Marker on the runtime-managed theme-color meta tag.

Runtime output; read it in selectors/styles instead of using it as an activation command.

Value syntax: presence.
